title: Analysis code for: Longitudinal Genome-Wide Association Study of Bone Mineral Density in Black, Hispanic, and American Indian/Alaska Native Postmenopausal Women from the Women's Health Initiative
description: Genotype rebuild, TrajGWAS analysis, Framingham Heart Study look-up, and figure/table scripts for a longitudinal GWAS of hip and spine bone mineral density in the Women's Health Initiative. Code only: no individual-level data. The data are available to approved users from dbGaP.
